description_en: Queries the status of an asynchronous document format conversion task by calling the GetOfficeConversionTask operation
description_zh: 调用GetOfficeConversionTask接口查询异步文档格式转换任务的状态信息
name: GetOfficeConversionTask

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. The TaskId returned after the CreateOfficeConversionTask operation is called.

You can obtain the TaskId of an asynchronous document format conversion task from the event query tab of the corresponding project in the Intelligent Media Management (IMM) console
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。CreateOfficeConversionTask接口执行后返回的TaskId。

异步文档格式转换任务的TaskId可以通过智能媒体管理控制台对应项目的任务查询页签获取
parameters.name: task_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

ExternalID.description_en:
This parameter is not supported in the current version.

The external tag of the task
ExternalID.description_zh:
当前版本不支持此参数。

任务的外部标签

FailDetail.description_en: The fault information of the task execute
FailDetail.description_zh: 任务执行对应的错误信息

FinishTime.description_en:
The time when the task ended.

This parameter has a value only when the task status is Finished. Otherwise, an empty value is returned
FinishTime.description_zh:
任务的结束时间。

当任务状态为Finished时，此参数才有值，否则返回值为空

ImageSpec.description_en:
This parameter is not supported in the current version.

The boundary size of the output image. Default value: 1024 pixels.

When the image width and height are different, the image is proportionally scaled based on whichever dimension reaches the boundary first
ImageSpec.description_zh:
当前版本不支持此参数。

输出图片的边界大小，默认值为1024像素。

当图片长宽不同时，按照最先到达边界的条件进行等比例控制

NotifyEndpoint.description_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter was not specified when the task was created, an empty value is returned
NotifyEndpoint.description_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

NotifyTopicName.description_en:
The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter was not specified when the task was created, an empty value is returned
NotifyTopicName.description_zh:
异步反向通知的TopicName。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

PageCount.description_en: The number of pages converted during the document format conversion

Percent.description_en:
The task progress percentage. Currently, only two values are returned: 0 and 100.

This parameter returns 100 only when the conversion succeeds. In all other cases, the value is 0
Percent.description_zh:
任务进度的百分比。当前只有0和100两个结果。

只有当转换成功时，此参数的返回值才为100，其他情况均为0

SrcUri.description_en: The storage location of the source data

Status.description_en:
The task running status. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Finished: The task is complete and the conversion succeeded.
Failed: The task is complete but the conversion failed. For the specific failure cause, see the Code in FailDetail
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。包括如下选项：

Running：任务运行中。
Finished：任务执行完成，转换成功。
Failed：任务执行完成，转换失败。具体失败原因请参考FaileDetail的Code内容

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is the same as the one in the request

TgtType.description_en: The target file type of the conversion output
TgtType.description_zh: 转换输出的目标文件类型

TgtUri.description_en: The destination location of the converted output content
TgtUri.description_zh: 转换后输出内容的目标位置
